Weekly U.S. Influenza Surveillance Report

On February 14, 2025, United States influenza surveillance reported 2,450 influenza cases, 2,100 confirmed cases, 64,000 tests, 6.4% positivity, 120 hospitalizations, and 4 deaths. This fixture represents an official report page summary and does not access the live CDC website.

Influenza-like illness activity remained elevated in multiple regions.
